theme.name: Free basic digital skills training
theme.claim: The government will offer publicly-funded basic digital skills training free of charge to all adults in England who need it, so they can get the skills for modern life and the jobs of the future.

text.line: The proposals, to be included in an amendment to the Digital Economy Bill, will mean publicly-funded basic digital skills training being offered free of charge to adults in England who need it.
We will make sure all adults who need it can receive free training in digital skills to equip them for the modern world.
Our reforms will mean that people who lack basic digital skills will get the training they need to get on the ladder of opportunity for the jobs of the future.
